## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -15.84%) ↓ falling and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +1.09%) ↑ rising provide risk-on signals while SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.39% | 1M: +3.40%) shows short-term equity weakness — mixed confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Fear easing via VXX (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -15.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and commodity/gold strength: GLD (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-stable: UUP RECOVERY (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -1.96%) and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.72%) — short-term support in dollar and duration but no clear trend acceleration.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Rotation nuance: Financials and Materials showing leadership — XLF (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +5.75%) ABOVE TREND, while Tech is in CORRECTION — XLK (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION; style: Value/cyclicals pick up vs Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities mixed: SPY (1W: -0.39% | 1M: +3.40%) CORRECTION. EM outperforming on momentum: EEM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.28%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
High-risk appetite evident: IBIT (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.96% | 1M: +18.40%) ABOVE TREND, while small-caps IWM (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +1.90%) CORRECTION shows short-term pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/precious metals strong: CPER (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +4.51%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +2.63% | 1M: +19.13%) ABOVE TREND; GLD (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND signals continued safe-haven/real-asset demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed/pulling back: XLE (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +8.44%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -3.40% | 1M: +8.13%) CORRECTION, while nat-gas UNG (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +6.22%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising — divergence within the energy complex.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Credit proxies HYG (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: multiple equities (SPY, QQQ, XLK) in CORRECTION (1W negative / 1M positive) — a MINOR divergence pattern, not a regime flip.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and credit exposure (XLF (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +5.75%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor IBIT/ARKK for speculative momentum; reduce exposure to short-term tech weakness (XLK (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +5.75%) ABOVE TREND and Financials XLF (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +4.51%) ABOVE TREND and Silver SLV (1W: +2.63% | 1M: +19.13%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Brent BNO (1W: -3.40% | 1M: +8.13%) CORRECTION and crude ETF USO (1W: -2.72% | 1M: +5.69%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -15.84%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND — monitor HYG/LQD near 0.80 for credit health. XLK (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION vs XLF (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND — watch XLK/XLF cross ~2.0 for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Materials and Financials showing relative strength (XLB (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +5.75%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND) while Tech (XLK (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +6.87%) CORRECTION) lags.  
Key risk: short-term equity divergences (SPY/QQQ/XLK in CORRECTION) amid easing credit/fear signals (HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND; VXX BELOW TREND) — monitor for either re-acceleration or broader rollover.
